description: Validate and pretty-print a string that is ALREADY valid JSON. Strict by design — it is a validity gate: valid JSON comes back formatted, anything else is rejected with the exact parse error. It never repairs, completes, or guesses. NOT for: plain text or prose (will fail), JSON embedded in markdown/prose (use extract_json_from_text first), JS objects (JSON.stringify them first), YAML (use yaml_to_json).

input.description: A raw JSON string, e.g. '{"key":"value"}'. Must already parse as JSON — plain text or truncated JSON is rejected, not repaired.

name: format_json
